name: scion
title_zh: 把 Google 云上 8 个运维技能打包成一套可装
tagline_zh: 别人在控制台里点半天，你一条命令装完 8 个运维技能。从日志诊断到成本排查，全是 Google 云官方沉淀的套路。
tagline_en: While others click through consoles, you install 8 Google Cloud ops skills in one go. Official patterns for.
why_zh: 官方仓库直接出包，技能间有共享上下文，能串起来用。不是单个工具的堆叠，而是按真实运维流程编排好的组合拳。
why_en: Straight from the official repo, skills share context and chain together. Not a tool pile—a choreographed combo for real ops.
limit_zh: 只认 Google Cloud 生态，AWS/Azure 一概不碰。装完是 8 个独立 skill。
limit_en: Google Cloud only—no AWS/Azure. Ships 8 standalone skills, no runtime or credential handling; you must configure gcloud and project IAM yourself.
